tagline: Advancing district-scale porphyry exploration in British Columbia
hero_kpi_rationale: The 'AuRORA Grade' KPI is the primary driver as it demonstrates exceptionally high mineralization (2.6 g/t Au) near surface, unusual for a new porphyry deposit, positioning AuRORA as a major strategic asset within the exploration portfolio.

kpis.name: AuRORA Discovery Grade
kpis.explanation: Average gold grade from key near-surface drill intercepts.
kpis.description: Key intercepts such as JP24057 show 2.6 g/t Au over 70 m, indicating high potential.
kpis.signal: High grade near surface, atypical for a new porphyry deposit.

kpis.name: Freeport Funding Commitment
kpis.explanation: Total funding commitment through the strategic partnership with Freeport McMoRan.
kpis.description: Freeport has paid $51M for 60% and committed to an additional $59M for 10%.
kpis.signal: Major commitment from Freeport validates project potential.

kpis.name: Market Capitalization
kpis.explanation: Total market value of outstanding shares.
kpis.description: Valued at $282 million as of February 2, 2026.
kpis.signal: Modest size, typical of a junior mining company.

kpis.name: Planned 2025 Drill Program
kpis.explanation: Total planned drilling length to explore the AuRORA deposit.
kpis.description: 15,381 meters planned for 2025 at the JOY / AuRORA site.
kpis.signal: Intensive 2025 program to confirm deposit extent.

kpis.name: Management and Sutton Group Ownership
kpis.explanation: Percentage of shares held by management and the Sutton Group.
kpis.description: 39% of the capital held by management and Sutton Group.
kpis.signal: Strong alignment between shareholders and management.

risks.title: No Revenue and Ongoing Operating Losses
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental risk repeated 4 times in Item 1A with strong language ("no earnings", "net losses", "negative cash flows since inception"). Dominant placement at the beginning of the document. Stable trend but critical for company viability.

risks.title: Inherent Geological and Operational Risks in Mineral Exploration
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section listing exhaustive risks (unusual geological formations, fires, power failures, floods, landslides). Highly explicit language on unpredictability. Major categorical weight for a junior explorer.

risks.title: Critical Dependence on Regulatory and Environmental Approvals
risks.score_rationale: Two distinct sections emphasize approval timelines may exceed 10 years, with categorical language ("no assurance"). Specific to the highly regulated Canadian mining sector. Stable trend but major structural risk.

risks.title: Risks Related to First Nations Relations
risks.score_rationale: Specific section notes properties are in claimed First Nations territories, with potential for permit delays or opposition. Moderate language but acknowledges impact on expected revenues. Stable trend, increasing weight in the Canadian context.

risks.title: Intense Competition from Better-Resourced Major Miners
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section highlights major mining companies have significant competitive advantages in capital, technical expertise, and operational experience. Explicit language on Amarc's disadvantages. Stable, sector-structural trend.

risks.title: Reliance on External Consultants and Limited Key Personnel
risks.score_rationale: Two separate sections (small team, consultant reliance) emphasize no assurance of availability or retention. Repetitive language on inability to guarantee access to required expertise. Stable but critical for a junior explorer.

risks.title: Environmental and Uninsurable Liability Risks
risks.score_rationale: Specific section on uninsurable risks (pollution, unusual geological formations) noting liabilities could exceed coverage limits. Moderate language but acknowledges significant exposure. Stable trend.

risks.title: Insufficient Funding and Inevitable Shareholder Dilution
risks.score_rationale: Multiple sections highlight lack of working capital, no assurance of obtaining financing, and inevitable dilution through share issuances. Repetitive and categorical language. Stable trend but major structural risk for current shareholders.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or advanced digital technologies in the provided documents. The company focuses exclusively on traditional mineral exploration and development.
evidence: No reference to AI in press releases
No mention of digitalization or automation
Focus on conventional drilling and geological analysis
